questions.prompt: If \(\theta\) is the angle between \(\vec a=12\hat i-3\hat j-4\hat k\) and \(\vec b=4\hat i-7\hat j+4\hat k\), find \(\cos\theta\). ______

questions.prompt: Find the area of the triangle with vertices \((-3, -1)\), \((0, -2)\), \((2, 2)\). ______

questions.prompt: Find the area of the parallelogram whose adjacent sides are \(\vec a=4\hat i-4\hat j+2\hat k\) and \(\vec b=-2\hat i+3\hat j\). ______

questions.prompt: The midpoint of \(A(-5, 1, -3)\) and \(B(-1, 1, -9)\) has \(x\)-coordinate ______

questions.prompt: Find \(\vec a\cdot\vec b\times\vec c\) for \(\vec a=\hat i+\hat j+2\hat k\), \(\vec b=-3\hat i-\hat k\), \(\vec c=-3\hat i+2\hat j-3\hat k\). ______

questions.prompt: For \(A(-5, -1, 3)\) and \(B(0, -3, -5)\), the coefficient of \(\hat k\) in \(\overrightarrow{AB}\) is ______

questions.prompt: Find \(\lambda\) so that \(\vec a=-2\hat i-4\hat j+\hat k\) is parallel to \(\vec b=-\hat i-2\hat j+\lambda\hat k\). ______

questions.prompt: Find \(\sin\theta\), where \(\theta\) is the angle between \(\vec a=10\hat i+11\hat j-2\hat k\) and \(\vec b=10\hat i-10\hat j-5\hat k\). ______

questions.explanation: \(\vec a\cdot\vec b\times\vec c=\begin{vmatrix}0&-3&-3\\-1&1&-3\\0&3&-1\end{vmatrix}=12\).

questions.prompt: Find the area of the triangle with vertices \(A(0, 1, -1)\), \(B(0, -1, -1)\), \(C(0, 2, 3)\). ______

questions.explanation: Perpendicular \(\Leftrightarrow\) dot product \(=0\): \(-2(-1)+(-4)(3)+\lambda(-1)=0\Rightarrow\lambda=-10\).

questions.prompt: A constant force \(\vec F=-3\hat j\) moves a particle from \(P(-1, 2, -1)\) to \(Q(-1, 1, -2)\). Find the work done. ______
questions.explanation: Displacement \(\vec S=\overrightarrow{PQ}=Q-P=-\hat j-\hat k\). Work \(W=\vec F\cdot\vec S=3\) (units of work).

If \(\theta\) is the angle between \(\vec a=6\hat i+3\hat j+2\hat k\) and \(\vec b=8\hat i+4\hat j+\hat k\), find \(\cos\theta\). ______

questions.prompt: Find the distance between \(P(-2, -1, 2)\) and \(Q(-13, -11, 4)\). ______
Find \(\lambda\) so that \(\vec a=-\hat i+3\hat j+3\hat k\) is parallel to \(\vec b=-3\hat i+9\hat j+\lambda\hat k\). ______
questions.explanation: Parallel means \(\vec b=k\vec a\), i.e. equal ratios of components. From the first component \(k=\dfrac{-3}{-1}=3\), so \(\lambda=k\cdot(3)=9\).

questions.prompt: If \(|\vec a|=7\), \(|\vec b|=6\) and \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=-40\), find \(|\vec a\times\vec b|^2\). ______
questions.explanation: Lagrange identity: \(|\vec a\times\vec b|^2=|\vec a|^2|\vec b|^2-(\vec a\cdot\vec b)^2=49\cdot36-(-40)^2=164\).

questions.prompt: The unit vector along \(\vec a=\hat i-2\hat j+2\hat k\) has coefficient ______ of \(\hat i\) (fraction or decimal)

questions.prompt: If \(\theta\) is the angle between \(\vec a=12\hat i+6\hat j-12\hat k\) and \(\vec b=10\hat i+2\hat j-11\hat k\), find \(\cos\theta\). ______
Find \(\lambda\) so that \(\vec a=-2\hat i+3\hat j+\hat k\), \(\vec b=-2\hat i+2\hat j-2\hat k\), \(\vec c=2\hat i-2\hat j+\lambda\hat k\) are coplanar. ______
questions.explanation: Coplanar \(\Leftrightarrow\) \(\vec a\cdot\vec b\times\vec c=0\). Expanding the determinant gives \(2 lam - 4=0\), so \(\lambda=2\).

questions.prompt: If \(\theta\) is the angle between \(\vec a=-3\hat i-12\hat j+4\hat k\) and \(\vec b=6\hat i-6\hat j-3\hat k\), find \(\cos\theta\). ______
questions.explanation: \(|\vec a|=13\), \(|\vec b|=9\), \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=42\), so \(\cos\theta=\dfrac{42}{13\cdot9}=\frac{14}{39}\).

questions.prompt: Find the volume of the parallelepiped with adjacent edges \(\vec a=3\hat i-2\hat j-\hat k\), \(\vec b=-3\hat i-3\hat j+2\hat k\), \(\vec c=3\hat i+2\hat j-\hat k\). ______
questions.explanation: Volume \(=|\vec a\cdot\vec b\times\vec c|\). The determinant is \(-12\); volume (never negative) \(=12\) cubic units.

questions.prompt: Find the coefficient of \(\hat k\) in \(\vec a\times\vec b\) when \(\vec a=-3\hat i+4\hat j-3\hat k\) and \(\vec b=4\hat i+\hat j+\hat k\). ______
questions.explanation: \(\vec a\times\vec b=7\hat i-9\hat j-19\hat k\); the coefficient of \(\hat k\) is \(-19\). (For \(\hat j\) remember the minus sign in the determinant.)

questions.prompt: For which value of \(t\) are \(A(3, -2, -1)\), \(B(1, 1, -4)\) and \(C(5, -5, t)\) collinear? ______
questions.explanation: \(\overrightarrow{AB}=-2\hat i+3\hat j-3\hat k\) and \(\overrightarrow{AC}\) must be parallel to it. The first two components give \(\overrightarrow{AC}=-1\,\overrightarrow{AB}\), so \(t=z_A+-1(-3)=2\).

questions.prompt: Find the coefficient of \(\hat i\) in \(\vec a\times\vec b\) when \(\vec a=-\hat i+2\hat k\) and \(\vec b=-2\hat i+2\hat j-4\hat k\). ______

questions.prompt: Find the area of the triangle with vertices \(A(-2, -4, -2)\), \(B(-4, -4, -3)\), \(C(0, -4, -2)\). ______
questions.explanation: \(\overrightarrow{AB}=-2\hat i-\hat k\), \(\overrightarrow{AC}=2\hat i\); \(\overrightarrow{AB}\times\overrightarrow{AC}=-2\hat j\). Area \(=\tfrac12|\overrightarrow{AB}\times\overrightarrow{AC}|=\tfrac12\sqrt{4}=1\).

questions.prompt: Find the volume of the tetrahedron with vertices \(A(0, 2, -2)\), \(B(-1, 5, -5)\), \(C(0, -1, -5)\), \(D(3, -1, 0)\). ______
questions.explanation: \(\overrightarrow{AB}=-\hat i+3\hat j-3\hat k\), \(\overrightarrow{AC}=-3\hat j-3\hat k\), \(\overrightarrow{AD}=3\hat i-3\hat j+2\hat k\); determinant \(=-39\). Volume \(=\tfrac16|-39|=\frac{13}{2}\).

questions.prompt: Find the area of the parallelogram whose adjacent sides are \(\vec a=-2\hat i-4\hat j+4\hat k\) and \(\vec b=4\hat i-4\hat k\). ______
questions.explanation: Area \(=|\vec a\times\vec b|\). \(\vec a\times\vec b=16\hat i+8\hat j+16\hat k\), so area \(=\sqrt{576}=24\).

questions.prompt: Find the volume of the parallelepiped with adjacent edges \(\vec a=2\hat i+3\hat k\), \(\vec b=\hat i-2\hat j-2\hat k\), \(\vec c=2\hat i-2\hat j+3\hat k\). ______
questions.explanation: Volume \(=|\vec a\cdot\vec b\times\vec c|\). The determinant is \(-14\); volume (never negative) \(=14\) cubic units.

questions.prompt: Find the area of the triangle with vertices \(A(3, 3, 0)\), \(B(0, -2, 3)\), \(C(3, -1, -1)\). ______
questions.explanation: \(\overrightarrow{AB}=-3\hat i-5\hat j+3\hat k\), \(\overrightarrow{AC}=-4\hat j-\hat k\); \(\overrightarrow{AB}\times\overrightarrow{AC}=17\hat i-3\hat j+12\hat k\). Area \(=\tfrac12|\overrightarrow{AB}\times\overrightarrow{AC}|=\tfrac12\sqrt{442}=\frac{\sqrt{442}}{2}\).

questions.prompt: Find \(\lambda\) so that \(\hat i-2\hat j+\lambda\hat k\) is perpendicular to \(\hat i+4\hat j+\hat k\). ______
questions.explanation: Perpendicular \(\Leftrightarrow\) dot product \(=0\): \(1(1)+(-2)(4)+\lambda(1)=0\Rightarrow\lambda=7\).

questions.prompt: The coordinate planes meet at the point called the ______.

questions.prompt: A force of 20 N is applied at a distance of 2 m from a hinge. The angle between the force and the line from the hinge to the point of application is \(150^\circ\). Find the magnitude of the moment (N m). ______
questions.explanation: \(|\vec M|=|\vec r||\vec F|\sin\theta=2\times20\times\sin150^\circ=20\) N m.

questions.prompt: If \(|\vec a|=5\), \(|\vec b|=4\) and the angle between them is \(60^\circ\), find \(|\vec a-\vec b|\). ______
